text:
jon: Quick sync  cloud marketplace onboarding checklist. Need SKU IDs, pricing modes, and a one-paragraph data-handling blurb for legal by EOD Fri. Who's on it?
keiko: I can own SKU surface. Thinking small/standard/enterprise -> RW-CPU2 / RW-CPU4 / RW-CPU8 to match cloud VM sizes. Keeps mapping obvious for customers.
dilip: FYI Azure requires a single managed image in the offer. We can publish multiple VM sizes under that offer, but metered usage UI is limited. Might have to GA with subscription only on Azure.
maria-legal: Legal asks: provide (1) short data-handling paragraph, (2) cancellation/refund snippet (one-liner), and (3) whether metered billing is used. Also attach the customer-facing privacy link.
marketplace-bot: Task created: partners/marketplace#932 "SKU + legal blurbs for GA" https://tasks.example/932
keiko: Draft SKU CSV plan:
```
sku_id,cloud,vm_profile,billing_mode,monthly_equiv_usd
RW-AWS-CPU2,AWS,2vCPU-4GB,metered,49
RW-GCP-CPU4,GCP,4vCPU-8GB,metered,95
RW-AZ-CPU8,Azure,8vCPU-32GB,subscription,480
```
keiko: Note the Azure line shows subscription for GA; we will add metered later after verifying partner-center metering support.
dilip: Ops notes: AMI/image naming must be stable: use rw-inference-v{semver}-build{hash}. Sign images. Also publish per-region AMIs for AWS. GCP uses image family tags. Azure needs manifest + single managed image.
maria-legal: Draft data blurb for review: "Redwood processes inference requests and retains token-level metadata for billing and diagnostics. Raw customer payloads are transient and not persisted for analytics unless explicitly enabled by the customer. Private/Dedicated deployments can be configured to prevent metadata retention and integrate with customer-managed keys."
keiko: Suggest small edit: replace "not persisted" with "not retained beyond transient processing" to avoid absolute claims.
maria-legal: Updated: "Redwood processes inference requests and retains token-level metadata for billing and diagnostics. Raw customer payloads are not retained beyond transient processing unless explicitly enabled by the customer. Private/Dedicated deployments can be configured to prevent metadata retention and integrate with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)."
dilip: Good. Add TLS + encryption line for listing: "All traffic TLS-encrypted; encryption at rest for marketplace images; Private deployments support customer KMS."
keiko: Marketing needs 50-char copy for each SKU. Drafts: 
- "Redwood Inference — up to 2 vCPU, usage billed"
- "Redwood Inference — up to 4 vCPU, scalable"
- "Redwood Inference — 8 vCPU, reserved performance"
keiko: I'll refine to 60 chars max per marketplace constraints and drop into /assets/marketplace/one-liners.txt.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: onboarding-template v3 uploaded to /drive/marketplace/onboard-v3.md
jon: Action items: keiko -> final SKU CSV + one-liners by Thu; dilip -> publish image checklist (AMI family, signing, region mapping) + confirm Azure manifest by Wed; maria-legal -> finalize data blurb + 2-line refund/cancel policy by Thu AM. I'll coordinate with finance for monthly_equiv_usd parity.
marketplace-bot: Checklist updated partners/marketplace#932 status: in-progress
maria-legal: Refund snippet: "Cancellation: monthly subscriptions cancel at period end; refunds handled case-by-case per marketplace policies."
dilip: Ops follow-up: we'll also need the usage reporting endpoint format for AWS/GCP metered billing. @keiko please include a sample row in the CSV export.
keiko: Will do. Also adding SKU->ledger_code mapping column per finance request.
jon: Great. We'll reconvene after items complete. Thanks team :thumbsup:
